mode_postprocessing.recipe: galerkin.mode_overlap in the kernel frame (the micrometre mesh whose nodes times 1e-6 are node_coordinates, the conjugated saved fields under exp(+i omega t), k0 = 2 pi / wavelength in 1/um), then areas times 1e-12 and complex values conjugated once; on node_coordinates in metres the same calls agree to rounding; see simcase.mode_postprocessing

unnormalized_mode_power.description: complex Poynting integral 1/2 int (E x H*).z dA of the saved relative field read as V/m (max centroid |E| = 1); Re is the +z time-averaged power, Im reactive (roundoff when lossless); divide the field by sqrt(Re P) for 1 W

confinement_factor.description: energy fraction int_R Re(eps_r) |E|^2 / int Re(eps_r) |E|^2 per region; rows sum to 1

unnormalized_field_overlap.description: <E_a, E_b> = int conj(E_a) . E_b dA of the saved fields (Hermitian); the diagonal is the mass norm int |E|^2 dA

te_polarization_fraction.description: f_TE = sum_T A_T |E_x|^2 / sum_T A_T (|E_x|^2 + |E_y|^2) on the saved centroid field unnormalized_electric_field over every triangle of the window, x horizontal, E_z left out; f_TM = 1 - f_TE. For two modes whose Re n_eff differ by at most 1e-3 (a degenerate pair) each member's value is an arbitrary rotation within the pair and is still saved; only the pair's sum is defined. A mesh split of a symmetric pair above 1e-3 (very coarse meshes) is not recognised, and a member's value is then a rotation chosen by the mesh

effective_area.description: A_eff = (sum_T A_T |E|^2)^2 / sum_T A_T |E|^4 on the saved centroid field unnormalized_electric_field over every triangle of the window, |E|^2 = |E_x|^2 + |E_y|^2 + |E_z|^2; the common mode-solver effective area, not the vectorial nonlinear area of Afshar and Monro. Each member of a degenerate pair has its own value, which depends on the rotation within the pair
